entry.en: Your passport should have an expiry date after the day you plan to leave Chile.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento posterior al día en que planeas salir de Chile.
entry.quote: Your passport should have an ‘expiry date’ after the day you plan to leave Chile.

entry.en: Chilean immigration gives you a tourist card (tarjeta de turismo) that you must keep and hand over when you leave the country.
entry.es: Inmigración chilena te da una tarjeta de turismo que debes conservar y entregar al salir del país.
entry.quote: The Chilean immigration authorities will give you a tourist card (‘tarjeta de turismo’), an A5-sized white form. Keep it safe and give it to immigration when you leave the country.

entry.en: Chile requires children travelling with one parent, a guardian or alone to have permission from the non-travelling parent or parents.
entry.es: Chile exige que los menores que viajan con un solo progenitor, con un tutor o solos tengan permiso del progenitor o progenitores que no viajan.
entry.quote: Chile requires children travelling with only one parent, with a guardian or alone, to have permission from the non-travelling parent or parents.

entry.en: To enter Rapa Nui (Easter Island) you must complete an entry form and show a return ticket.
entry.es: Para entrar a Rapa Nui (Isla de Pascua) debes completar un formulario de entrada y mostrar un pasaje de regreso.
entry.quote:
To enter Rapa Nui (Easter Island) you must:

- complete a Rapa Nui entry form

- show a return ticket

entry.en: There are strict rules on goods taken into or out of Chile, and you must declare anything prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Hay reglas estrictas sobre los bienes que se pueden llevar a Chile o sacar de él, y debes declarar lo prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Chile. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Pickpocketing, mugging and thefts from vehicles are very common throughout Chile, including at airports, hotels and bus stations.
safety.es: Los carteristas, asaltos y robos en vehículos son muy comunes en todo Chile, incluidos aeropuertos, hoteles y terminales de buses.
safety.quote: Pickpocketing, mugging and thefts from vehicles are very common throughout Chile, including inside airports, churches, hotels and bus stations, and at viewpoints and petrol stations.

safety.en: Many foreign visitors have been scammed for large sums by unlicensed taxi drivers, including airport taxis.
safety.es: Muchos visitantes extranjeros han sido estafados por grandes sumas por taxistas sin licencia, incluidos taxis del aeropuerto.
safety.quote: Many foreign visitors have been scammed for large amounts of money by unlicensed taxi drivers, including in airport taxis.

safety.en: Only book and pay for official taxis from inside the airport before exiting the building.
safety.es: Reserva y paga solo taxis oficiales dentro del aeropuerto antes de salir del edificio.
safety.quote: Only book and pay for official taxis from inside the airport before exiting the building.

safety.en: There is a risk of violent protest in Santiago and other Chilean cities, particularly on Friday afternoons and evenings.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de protestas violentas en Santiago y otras ciudades chilenas, sobre todo los viernes por la tarde y la noche.
safety.quote: There is a risk of violent protest in Santiago and other Chilean cities, particularly on Friday afternoons and evenings.

safety.en: Major earthquakes are a risk in Chile.
safety.es: Los grandes terremotos son un riesgo en Chile.
safety.quote: Major earthquakes are a risk in Chile.

safety.en: There is ongoing civil unrest in the Araucanía Region, especially around Temuco.
safety.es: Hay disturbios civiles continuos en la región de La Araucanía, especialmente en torno a Temuco.
safety.quote: There is ongoing civil unrest in the Araucanía Region, especially around Temuco.

health.en: There are confirmed cases of dengue fever on Rapa Nui (Easter Island), so avoid mosquito bites.
health.es: Hay casos confirmados de dengue en Rapa Nui (Isla de Pascua), por lo que conviene evitar las picaduras de mosquitos.
health.quote: There are confirmed cases of dengue fever on Rapa Nui (Easter Island). Take steps to avoid being bitten by mosquitoes.

health.en: There are good health facilities in Santiago and other major cities, but private clinics and hospitals are expensive.
health.es: Hay buenos centros de salud en Santiago y otras grandes ciudades, pero las clínicas y hospitales privados son caros.
health.quote: There are good health facilities in Santiago and other major cities, but private clinics and hospitals are expensive.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink, according to Wikivoyage.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber, según Wikivoyage.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink.

health.en: Wikivoyage says the hepatitis A vaccine is recommended for all travelers.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que se recomienda la vacuna contra la hepatitis A para todos los viajeros.
health.quote: Hepatitis A vaccine is recommended for all travelers.

health.es: El hantavirus está presente en Chile.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Chile are 131 for ambulance, 132 for fire and 133 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Chile son 131 (ambulancia), 132 (bomberos) y 133 (policía).

getting_in.en: The most common entry point for overseas visitors is Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport (SCL) north-west of downtown Santiago.
getting_in.es: El punto de entrada más común para visitantes extranjeros es el Aeropuerto Internacional Arturo Merino Benítez (SCL), al noroeste del centro de Santiago.
getting_in.quote: The most common entry point for overseas visitors is the Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport (SCL IATA) in the commune of Pudahuel, 15 km (9.3 miles) north-west of downtown Santiago.

getting_in.en: Other airports with international service are in Arica, Iquique, Antofagasta, Calama, Puerto Montt and Punta Arenas, all to neighbouring countries.
getting_in.es: Otros aeropuertos con servicio internacional están en Arica, Iquique, Antofagasta, Calama, Puerto Montt y Punta Arenas, todos hacia países vecinos.
getting_in.quote: Other airports with international services are in Arica, Iquique, Antofagasta, Calama, Puerto Montt and Punta Arenas, all of them to neighbouring countries.

getting_in.en: Buses from Argentina depart daily from Mendoza, Bariloche and San Martín de los Andes, and weekly from Buenos Aires.
getting_in.es: Los buses desde Argentina salen a diario de Mendoza, Bariloche y San Martín de los Andes, y semanalmente de Buenos Aires.
getting_in.quote: Buses from Argentina depart daily from Mendoza, Bariloche and San Martín de los Andes, and even from Buenos Aires weekly.

getting_in.en: In winter it is not uncommon for roads from Argentina to close for days at a time because of snow.
getting_in.es: En invierno no es raro que los caminos desde Argentina cierren durante días por la nieve.
getting_in.quote: it is not uncommon for roads from Argentina to close for days at a time because of snow.

getting_in.en: All bags of all international arrivals are screened by x-ray at airport customs stations.
getting_in.es: Todas las maletas de todos los pasajeros internacionales son revisadas con rayos X en las aduanas de los aeropuertos.
getting_in.quote: all bags of all international arrivals are screened by x-ray machines at airport customs stations.

getting_around.en: The bus system provides a cheap and comfortable way to get from town to town.
getting_around.es: El sistema de buses ofrece una forma barata y cómoda de ir de una ciudad a otra.
getting_around.quote: The bus system is sophisticated and provides a cheap and comfortable way to get from town to town.

getting_around.en: Buses are almost never full, so tickets can be bought at the station without reservation except during Chilean holidays.
getting_around.es: Los buses casi nunca van llenos, así que se puede comprar el boleto en la terminal sin reserva, salvo en feriados chilenos.
getting_around.quote: Buses are almost never full, so you can buy your ticket at the bus station without reservation, except during Chilean holidays (January–February, Easter and Fiestas Patrias).

getting_around.en: To travel by micro (bus) in Santiago you need a contactless BIP card that you charge with money.
getting_around.es: Para viajar en micro en Santiago necesitas una tarjeta sin contacto BIP cargada con dinero.
getting_around.quote: To travel by "micro" in Santiago you will need to buy before a smart contactless travel-card called "BIP" and charge it with money.

getting_around.en: The BIP card also lets you travel by subway in Santiago.
getting_around.es: La tarjeta BIP también permite viajar en metro en Santiago.
getting_around.quote: This card also allows you to travel by subway in Santiago.

getting_around.en: Driving is on the right, and it is mandatory to have the car lights on even during the day.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por la derecha y es obligatorio llevar las luces del auto encendidas incluso de día.
getting_around.quote: Driving is to the right, and the left lane on expressways is for overtaking, not "the fast lane". There is no right turn on red, except where explicitly signed (which is rare). It's mandatory to always have the car lights on, even during the day.

getting_around.en: If your driver's licence is not in Spanish, you also need an International Driver Permit to rent a car.
getting_around.es: Si tu licencia de conducir no está en español, también necesitas un permiso internacional de conducir para alquilar un auto.
getting_around.quote: If your driver's licence is not in Spanish, you also need an International Driver Permit (IDP).

money.en: Chile's currency is the Chilean peso (CLP), denoted by the symbol "$".
money.es: La moneda de Chile es el peso chileno (CLP), representado con el símbolo "$".
money.quote: Chile's currency is the Chilean peso (ISO code: CLP), denoted by the symbol "$".

money.en: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted in independent shops in major cities and in all chain stores.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito se aceptan ampliamente en el comercio independiente de las grandes ciudades y en todas las cadenas.
money.quote: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted in most of the independent commerce of major cities and in all chain stores, no matter where they are.

money.en: On card machines, Wikivoyage says foreigners should always select "sin" cuotas (without installments).
money.es: En los datáfonos, Wikivoyage indica que los extranjeros deben elegir siempre "sin" cuotas.
money.quote: you should always select sin (which means without).

money.en: Never exchange money on the street, especially if a "helper" asks you to follow them.
money.es: Nunca cambies dinero en la calle, sobre todo si un "ayudante" te pide que lo sigas.
money.quote: Never exchange money on the street, especially if a "helper" indicates you to follow them.

money.en: Tipping is not obligatory but generally expected, usually 10% if the service is satisfactory.
money.es: La propina no es obligatoria pero suele esperarse, normalmente un 10% si el servicio es satisfactorio.
money.quote: Tipping is not obligatory but is generally expected. It is usually assumed that customers will leave a tip of 10%, if the service is considered satisfactory.

money.en: Criminals sometimes install hard-to-detect skimmers and micro-cameras in some ATM facilities to clone cards.
money.es: A veces delincuentes instalan skimmers y microcámaras difíciles de detectar en algunos cajeros para clonar tarjetas.
money.quote: Criminals sometimes install hard-to-detect skimmers and micro-cameras in some less surveiled ATM facilities. These devices are meant to read your card's information to produce a clone.

etiquette.en: If someone offers you something, it is polite to say "Si, por favor" or "No, gracias"; only Si or No is considered rude.
etiquette.es: Si te ofrecen algo, es cortés decir "Sí, por favor" o "No, gracias"; decir solo Sí o No se considera descortés.
etiquette.quote: If someone offers you something, it's polite to say Si, por favor or No, gracias. Saying only Si or No is considered rude.

etiquette.en: Greetings are a handshake man-to-man, a cheek "kiss" man-to-woman, and a cheek kiss or hug woman-to-woman.
etiquette.es: Los saludos son un apretón de manos entre hombres, un beso en la mejilla entre hombre y mujer, y un beso o abrazo entre mujeres.
etiquette.quote: Chileans traditionally greet each other in three different ways: man-to-man greetings are a handshake, man-to-woman greetings are one "kiss" on the right cheek, and woman-to-woman greetings can be either a "kiss" on the right cheek or a hug.

etiquette.en: When arriving at or leaving a gathering, Chileans greet and say goodbye to every person individually.
etiquette.es: Al llegar o irse de una reunión, los chilenos saludan y se despiden de cada persona individualmente.
etiquette.quote: Chileans always greet every person there individually, and also say goodbye to every person individually.

etiquette.en: Discussions about the Pinochet regime (1973 to 1990) should be approached with absolute respect and caution.
etiquette.es: Las conversaciones sobre el régimen de Pinochet (1973 a 1990) deben abordarse con absoluto respeto y cautela.
etiquette.quote: The Pinochet military regime, which ruled the country from 1973 to 1990, is very much an open wound in Chile's national consciousness and discussions about it should be approached with absolute respect and caution.

etiquette.en: Football is taken extremely seriously in Chile.
etiquette.es: El fútbol se toma extremadamente en serio en Chile.
etiquette.quote: Football is taken extremely seriously in Chile.

connectivity.en: GSM SIM cards from ENTEL, Movistar or Claro are usually 5,000 pesos without credit, so you need to buy prepaid minutes.
connectivity.es: Las SIM GSM de ENTEL, Movistar o Claro suelen costar 5.000 pesos sin saldo, por lo que debes comprar minutos prepago.
connectivity.quote: GSM SIM cards from ENTEL, Movistar or Claro are usually available for 5,000 pesos, but without credit, so you'll need to buy some prepaid minutes to be able to call.

connectivity.en: No ID is required to buy a prepaid phone.
connectivity.es: No se requiere identificación para comprar un teléfono prepago.
connectivity.quote: No ID is required to buy a prepaid phone.

connectivity.en: Many rural towns have free WiFi in the central plaza or near the bus station, though reliability can vary.
connectivity.es: Muchos pueblos rurales tienen WiFi gratis en la plaza o cerca del terminal de buses, aunque la fiabilidad varía.
connectivity.quote: many rural towns nowadays have free WiFi somewhere in the centre (plaza) or near the bus station. However, the reliability of the Internet can vary.
